Precisely because the militia cannot be relied upon, troops must be recruited whenever bandits rise; precisely because military funds are difficult to replenish, borrowing to meet expenses is unavoidable whenever forces are mobilized. This is why troops and provisions are both in straitened circumstances.
Jiangyou has long enjoyed peace, and its people know nothing of warfare. Recently, refractory groups from the mountain thickets and remote stream valleys of Wu, Chu, Min, and Yue seized opportunities to rise in rebellion, ranging through and attacking Lin, Ji, and other prefectures. Fortunately, our Emperor took the southeast’s plight to heart and specially commanded the Grand Coordinator to dispatch troops to suppress and destroy them…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
玄威神武汛掃廓清起瘡痍之民而置之衽席
之上固皆遊於熈皞之天矣然猶思患預
防隨事為制建中營於省會而以遊擊領
之以待東西之應援建東營於南豐而以
參將領之以固吳楚之門戶建西營於萬
安而以守備領之以控閩粵之襟喉設險
守固靡不悉至誠有不戰而屈人兵先聲
而褫虜魄者矣但各營召募類非土著以
之戍守則歲月之無期餽之糧餉恐供億
===
之難繼故愚以為禦寇而藉召募之兵則
寇未至而我益勞守望而資土著之民則
寇可待而我常逸昔人云屯兵十年五年
無益言糜濫之可惜也又曰養兵十萬五
萬可去言老弱之當汰也為今之計不必
易民而教之也特教之者無其素耳誠能
於精常二兵慎其揀選汰其老弱而後畀
之閫帥使之更番操練專委任以責成之
則人人皆壯勇也何患乎兵之不足也哉
punctuated:
玄威神武，汛掃廓清，起瘡痍之民而置之衽席之上，固皆遊於熈皞之天矣。然猶思患預防，隨事為制：建中營於省會，而以遊擊領之，以待東西之應援；建東營於南豐，而以參將領之，以固吳楚之門戶；建西營於萬安，而以守備領之，以控閩粵之襟喉。設險守固，靡不悉至，誠有不戰而屈人兵、先聲而褫虜魄者矣。但各營召募，類非土著，以之戍守，則歲月之無期；餽之糧餉，恐供億之難繼。
故愚以為，禦寇而藉召募之兵，則寇未至而我益勞；守望而資土著之民，則寇可待而我常逸。昔人云：「屯兵十年，五年無益。」言糜濫之可惜也。又曰：「養兵十萬，五萬可去。」言老弱之當汰也。為今之計，不必易民而教之也，特教之者無其素耳。誠能於精常二兵慎其揀選，汰其老弱，而後畀之閫帥，使之更番操練，專委任以責成之，則人人皆壯勇也，何患乎兵之不足也哉！
translation_en:
…With awe-inspiring might and divine martial prowess, they swept away the enemy and cleared the region, lifting the war-stricken people onto comfortable bedding. All now live beneath a heaven of radiant harmony. Yet precautions against future trouble were still considered, and arrangements made as circumstances required. A central camp was established at the provincial capital under a Mobile Corps Commander, ready to provide support to east and west; an eastern camp at Nanfeng under an Assistant Regional Commander, to secure the gateway between Wu and Chu; and a western camp at Wan'an under a Commandant, to control the strategic approaches to Fujian and Guangdong. Every measure for establishing defenses and holding strong positions was thoroughly undertaken. Truly, these arrangements could subdue an enemy’s troops without battle and rob the foe of courage by their reputation alone. Yet those recruited into the various camps are mostly not local inhabitants. If employed on garrison duty, their service has no definite end; if supplied with provisions and pay, sustaining those supplies may prove difficult.
Thus, in my humble judgment, if we rely on recruited soldiers to repel raiders, we become increasingly exhausted before the raiders even arrive; if we rely on local inhabitants to keep watch, we can await the raiders while remaining rested. Someone of old said, “Of ten years of stationing troops, five bring no benefit.” This deplores wasteful and excessive expenditure. Another saying runs, “Of a hundred thousand soldiers maintained, fifty thousand could be dismissed.” This means that the old and weak should be weeded out. The present solution does not require replacing the men before training them; it is simply that their instructors have provided no regular training. If careful selection were made among the two categories of troops, elite and regular, and the old and weak were eliminated, the remaining men could then be entrusted to a regional military commander and made to train in rotation. Give him undivided responsibility and hold him accountable for results, and every man would become strong and courageous. Why then worry about a shortage of troops?

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
不必加賦而益之也特賦之者無其術耳
誠能於額編工食取之有時用之有節而
實惠於民兵毋令冒破虛耗督逋負而禁
絕之則時時有糗糒也何患乎食之不足
也哉夫如是而議銷兵則召募之眾可以
漸而遣也如是而議畜儲則汰兵之積可
以漸而盈也古之人深知兵食之不容已
而又不可以相離也趙充國賦田臨羌以
待先零之弊諸葛孔明雜耕渭濱以省成
===
都之運此役諸有籍之兵也今之田隸於
衞而屯屬於軍民兵雖欲屯其可得乎曹
瑋以閒田募弓弩手而爲前鋒黃好謙以
田募民保甲而代強壯此役諸無業之民
也今之地無遺利而民無遺力募兵雖欲
耕其可得乎惟保甲之法歷世可行而團
練之制庶幾有合誠能考其故而見諸行
則民不改聚而少壯可使兵不出鄉而行
伍可成較藝於平日使之各精其能而後
punctuated:
不必加賦而益之也，特賦之者無其術耳。誠能於額編工食，取之有時，用之有節，而實惠於民兵，毋令冒破虛耗，督逋負而禁絕之，則時時有糗糒也，何患乎食之不足也哉！夫如是而議銷兵，則召募之眾可以漸而遣也；如是而議畜儲，則汰兵之積可以漸而盈也。
古之人深知兵食之不容已，而又不可以相離也。趙充國賦田臨羌，以待先零之弊；諸葛孔明雜耕渭濱，以省成都之運：此役諸有籍之兵也。今之田隸於衞，而屯屬於軍，民兵雖欲屯，其可得乎？曹瑋以閒田募弓弩手而爲前鋒，黃好謙以田募民保甲而代強壯：此役諸無業之民也。今之地無遺利，而民無遺力，募兵雖欲耕，其可得乎？惟保甲之法歷世可行，而團練之制庶幾有合。誠能考其故而見諸行，則民不改聚而少壯可使，兵不出鄉而行伍可成。較藝於平日，使之各精其能，而後
translation_en:
There is no need to increase taxes to augment supplies; it is simply that those who levy them lack the proper methods. If the prescribed assessments for pay and provisions could indeed be collected at the proper times and spent with restraint, bringing real benefit to the militia, while fraudulent disbursements and waste were prevented and arrears pursued and eliminated, there would always be parched grain and dried rice. Why then worry about insufficient provisions? With matters thus arranged, if we discuss reducing the forces, the recruited troops could gradually be discharged; if we discuss building reserves, the stores accumulated through reductions in troop numbers could gradually grow abundant.
The men of antiquity understood well that neither troops nor provisions could be dispensed with, and that the two could not be separated. Zhao Chongguo allocated fields at Linqiang to await the exhaustion of the Xianling Qiang; Zhuge Kongming had his troops cultivate land interspersed among the inhabitants along the Wei River, reducing the transport of supplies from Chengdu. These measures employed soldiers already on the military registers. Today, however, the fields belong to the guards, and the military farms are assigned to military personnel. Even if the militia wished to establish farming colonies, could they do so? Cao Wei used idle fields to recruit bowmen and crossbowmen to serve as the vanguard; Huang Haoqian used land to recruit civilians into the baojia mutual-responsibility organization as a substitute for the able-bodied militia. These measures employed civilians without an established livelihood. Today no productive capacity of the land remains untapped, and the people have no labor to spare. Even if recruited soldiers wished to cultivate the land, could they do so? Only the baojia system remains practicable through successive ages, and the system of organizing and drilling local militia comes close to matching it. If its precedents could indeed be examined and put into practice, the young and able-bodied could be employed without changing where the people live, and military ranks could be formed without soldiers leaving their home districts. Test their skills in ordinary times, so that each perfects his abilities, and then…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
試用於臨時使之各效其力養之者雖不
出於屯田而意師夫古賦之者雖不出於
九則而制宜於今則戰守皆精壯而不食
無用之人軍餉有常經而不給無名之費
養之精而士氣作強銳足以禦侮矣節其
財而民力裕富庶足以供輸矣通變之宜
推行之利不外乎此又何待於加賦以足
用加募以振威哉抑又有說焉軍餉之需
已有定法江右土瘠民貧他無可以裨益
===
者吾不得而議之矣但團操之法講求蓋
已有年而迄無成效何哉訓練者不得其
人故也必欲撤遣召募而資藉團練可不
擇官以任之乎蓋田野之民一旦驅而之
戰非其所便習者況力有強弱稟有知愚
善敎者本之孝弟忠信以啓其良繼之坐
作進退以示其法與之弓矢甲冑以利其
器懸之號令賞罰以鼓其趨使之久而安
焉習而化焉如饑之欲食如寒之欲衣就
punctuated:
試用於臨時，使之各效其力。養之者雖不出於屯田，而意師夫古；賦之者雖不出於九則，而制宜於今。則戰守皆精壯，而不食無用之人；軍餉有常經，而不給無名之費。養之精而士氣作，強銳足以禦侮矣；節其財而民力裕，富庶足以供輸矣。通變之宜，推行之利，不外乎此，又何待於加賦以足用、加募以振威哉？抑又有說焉：軍餉之需，已有定法。江右土瘠民貧，他無可以裨益者，吾不得而議之矣。

但團操之法，講求蓋已有年，而迄無成效，何哉？訓練者不得其人故也。必欲撤遣召募而資藉團練，可不擇官以任之乎？蓋田野之民，一旦驅而之戰，非其所便習者。況力有強弱，稟有知愚。善敎者，本之孝弟忠信以啓其良，繼之坐作進退以示其法，與之弓矢甲冑以利其器，懸之號令賞罰以鼓其趨，使之久而安焉，習而化焉，如饑之欲食，如寒之欲衣，就
translation_en:
…then put them to the test when the occasion arises, so that each contributes his strength. Although their support would not come from military agricultural colonies, its guiding intent would follow antiquity; although taxation would not follow the Nine Principles, its arrangements would suit present conditions. Those who fight and defend would then all be vigorous and able, and no useless men would be fed. Military provisioning would have regular allocations, and no expenses without a legitimate purpose would be paid. With adequate support, the soldiers’ morale would rise, and their strength and fighting spirit would suffice to repel aggression. With economy in expenditure, the people’s resources would be ample, and their prosperity would suffice to furnish supplies. The proper means of adapting to changing circumstances, and the benefits of putting them into practice, extend no further than this. Why, then, need we wait for increased taxation to meet expenses, or further recruitment to enhance military might? There is, however, another point to make. Established rules already govern the requirements of military provisioning. In Jiangyou, the soil is poor and the people impoverished; there are no other resources that could supplement it, so I cannot propose anything further on that matter.

Yet methods of organizing and drilling local forces have surely been studied for years. Why have they still produced no results? Because the right men have not been found to train them. If we are determined to dismiss the recruited troops and rely on locally organized forces, can we fail to select suitable officials to take charge? Country people, suddenly driven into battle, face something unfamiliar to them. Moreover, some are strong and others weak; some are intelligent and others dull. A good instructor begins with filial devotion, respect for elder brothers, loyalty, and trustworthiness to awaken their goodness. He follows this with drills in sitting and rising, advancing and retreating, to demonstrate the proper procedures. He provides bows and arrows, armor and helmets, to equip them effectively, and publicly sets out commands, rewards, and punishments to spur their efforts. Over time, he makes them comfortable with these practices and transforms them through familiarity, until they take to them as the hungry desire food and the cold desire clothing, attending to…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
其資之所近而各成一藝之名則技能之
巧膂力之强將必有脫穎而出者由是以
一敎十雖百千萬人皆可化而爲兵彼將
遇敵而求以試之也又何患乎寇之至哉
愚故曰訓練者貴得其人此一得之見也
執事儻以爲然則條理節目之詳尤有可
言者惟進而敎之幸甚
punctuated: 其資之所近，而各成一藝之名，則技能之巧、膂力之强，將必有脫穎而出者。由是以一敎十，雖百千萬人，皆可化而爲兵。彼將遇敵而求以試之也，又何患乎寇之至哉？愚故曰：「訓練者貴得其人。」此一得之見也。執事儻以爲然，則條理節目之詳，尤有可言者。惟進而敎之，幸甚！
translation_en: …what best suits their natural capacities, so that each gains distinction in a particular skill, then men of outstanding skill and physical strength will surely emerge. In this way, with one man teaching ten, even hundreds, thousands, or tens of thousands can all be transformed into soldiers. When they encounter the enemy, they will seek to put their abilities to the test. What cause would there then be to fear the arrival of raiders? Thus I humbly say: “In training, the essential thing is to obtain the right men to conduct it.” This is my one modest insight. If you, Sir, consider it sound, there is still more to say about the detailed organization and procedures. I would be most grateful if you would summon me forward and instruct me.

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
江西鄉試錄後序
今歲甲子江西省大比士舉
其雋如
制得九十有五人將
獻賢能之書道瀾與匡之司役
考試已於事而竣故事宜有
序言序曰夫大江以西吳楚
===
之交江湖之隩區也是惟介
在閩粤南國之紀矣惟楚有
才自昔記之
明興以來貞亮翼輔之臣彬彬輩
出甲于諸藩省乃其舉士
制額自兩畿而下亦甲于諸藩省
誠爲多士賢也今多士舉于
punctuated:
江西鄉試錄後序

今歲甲子，江西省大比士，舉其雋，如制得九十有五人，將獻賢能之書。道瀾與匡之司役考試，已於事而竣。故事宜有序言。序曰：夫大江以西，吳楚之交，江湖之隩區也。是惟介在閩粤，南國之紀矣。惟楚有才，自昔記之。明興以來，貞亮翼輔之臣彬彬輩出，甲于諸藩省。乃其舉士制額，自兩畿而下，亦甲于諸藩省，誠爲多士賢也。今多士舉于
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Jiangxi Provincial Examination

This year, the jiazi year, Jiangxi Province held its triennial examination of scholars and selected the outstanding among them, obtaining ninety-five men in accordance with the regulations. The register of worthy and capable men is about to be presented. Daolan and Kuangzhi were charged with conducting the examination, and the work has now concluded [?]. Established practice calls for a prefatory statement. It reads:

The land west of the great Yangzi River, at the meeting of Wu and Chu, forms a sheltered region of rivers and lakes. Situated between Min and Yue, it is a binding cord of the southern realm. “Chu indeed has men of talent”: this has been recorded since antiquity. Since the rise of the Ming, steadfast and upright ministers who assist the sovereign have emerged in cultured succession, surpassing those of all other provinces. Its statutory quota for selecting scholars likewise ranks first among the provinces, after the two metropolitan regions. This is truly because it abounds in worthy scholars. Now these scholars have been selected at …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
鄉登名
天府將乘時顯庸矣亦繹思有
司者所以毖慎遴選意耶夫
有司者攄誠協恭期於以人
事君如治絲者然蠶繅紬繹
經之綸之以充筐篚衣裳黼
黻之需也然而經緯不同期
===
於為章也如治室者然掄求
山林度修絜鉅牽江輓陸以
輸將作宗廟明堂之具也然
而虔斲不同期於成材也又
如往大都者馳於阪飄於川
飭轅結靷周其帆檣以車以
舟引重致遠之資也然而遠
punctuated: 鄉，登名天府，將乘時顯庸矣。亦繹思有司者所以毖慎遴選意耶？夫有司者攄誠協恭，期於以人事君。如治絲者然，蠶繅紬繹，經之綸之，以充筐篚衣裳黼黻之需也。然而經緯不同，期於為章也。如治室者然，掄求山林，度修絜鉅，牽江輓陸，以輸將作宗廟明堂之具也。然而虔斲不同，期於成材也。又如往大都者，馳於阪，飄於川，飭轅結靷，周其帆檣，以車以舟，引重致遠之資也。然而遠
translation_en:
…at the Provincial Examination, and have their names entered in the imperial registers, they will seize the opportunity to render distinguished service. Have they also reflected upon the intent behind the responsible officials’ painstaking care in selection? These officials give full expression to their sincerity and work together with reverence, seeking to serve their sovereign by furnishing him with worthy men.

It is like preparing silk: raising silkworms, reeling and drawing out their silk, arranging and twisting the threads, to supply the needs of basket-borne offerings, robes, and embroidered ceremonial insignia. Yet although warp and weft differ, their common purpose is to form a pattern.

It is like constructing a building: searching the mountain forests for suitable timber, measuring its length and girth, hauling it along rivers and overland, and delivering to the Directorate for Palace Buildings the materials for ancestral temples and the Hall of Enlightened Rule. Yet although the cutting and hewing [?] differ, their common purpose is to produce usable timber.

Again, it is like traveling to a great metropolis: speeding over slopes and sailing along rivers, putting shafts in order and fastening traces, making sails and masts ready—all these furnish the means, by cart or boat, to transport heavy loads over long distances. Yet although the distant…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
近不同期於共致也是數者
爲道不同期於適用也有司
者之於士謹科條明敎化聯
之師儒以儲養於鄉國者非
一日矣今玆殫精竭智朝夕
匪懈披沙見寳觸目琳琅亦
至勤矣誠不異於前數者之
===
求於用哉仰惟
皇上道久化成四海厎治然乃
加惠元元登用賢哲廣厲風敎
嵗飭功令惓惓焉以共成
雍煕悠久之盛多士者亦又服
膺
德意潔齊快覩雲蒸虎變千載
punctuated:
近不同，期於共致也。是數者，爲道不同，期於適用也。有司者之於士，謹科條，明敎化，聯之師儒，以儲養於鄉國者，非一日矣。今玆殫精竭智，朝夕匪懈，披沙見寳，觸目琳琅，亦至勤矣。誠不異於前數者之求於用哉！
仰惟皇上道久化成，四海厎治，然乃加惠元元，登用賢哲，廣厲風敎，嵗飭功令，惓惓焉以共成雍煕悠久之盛。多士者亦又服膺德意，潔齊快覩，雲蒸虎變，千載
translation_en:
…though the distances differ, the aim is to bring all to their destinations. In these several undertakings, the methods differ, but the aim is fitness for use. In their dealings with scholars, the responsible officials have carefully observed the examination regulations, made moral instruction clear, and brought scholars into association with learned teachers, nurturing a reserve of talent in the localities and throughout the realm. This has continued for many a day. Now they have exhausted their energies and ingenuity, remaining tireless morning and night, sifting sand to reveal treasures, with fine jade meeting their eyes everywhere. Their diligence has indeed been utmost. Surely their pursuit of useful talent is no different from the several undertakings described above!
We reverently reflect that His Majesty’s Way has long prevailed, his transforming influence has reached fruition, and all within the Four Seas has attained good government. Yet he further bestows kindness upon the common people, promotes and employs the worthy and wise, broadly encourages moral instruction, and each year enjoins observance of the examination ordinances. With unflagging solicitude, he seeks to bring about, together with others, an enduring age of harmony and prosperity. The many scholars likewise take his benevolent intentions to heart, purify and compose themselves, and joyfully behold talent rising like clouds and attaining the splendid transformation of a tiger’s markings—in a thousand years…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
一時矣毋亦慎所趨以求不
負於用耳昔者墨子惜絲之
染非能無染也懼所以染之
者非也匠氏之不勝任以其
斲而小之然材或堅外而中
液也楊氏逢岐路而有感以
多岐則衆惑競趨也其於士
===
亦然是故五色宣炳文章之
華也染之而非則玄黃而紺
紫之矣隆棟藻梲大壯之觀
也眩於用而無實則棟梁而
榱桷之矣殊途同歸達道之
致一也以虛車弊舟而趨狹
邪沿汙潦焉則戾矣是故染
punctuated:
一時矣！毋亦慎所趨，以求不負於用耳。昔者墨子惜絲之染，非能無染也，懼所以染之者非也。匠氏之不勝任，以其斲而小之，然材或堅外而中液也。楊氏逢岐路而有感，以多岐則衆惑競趨也。其於士亦然。
是故五色宣炳，文章之華也；染之而非，則玄黃而紺紫之矣。隆棟藻梲，大壯之觀也；眩於用而無實，則棟梁而榱桷之矣。殊途同歸，達道之致一也；以虛車弊舟而趨狹邪，沿汙潦焉，則戾矣。是故染
translation_en:
…a moment such as this! Should scholars not take care in choosing the direction they pursue, seeking only not to fail when put to use? Long ago, Mozi lamented the dyeing of silk—not because it could remain undyed, but because he feared that what dyed it might be wrong. When a craftsman’s timber cannot bear its load, it is because he has hewn it down and made it small; yet some timber may be hard outside but soft within. Master Yang was moved upon encountering a fork in the road, because many divergent paths leave people bewildered and rushing in competing directions. So it is with scholars.
Thus, the five colors shining brilliantly constitute the splendor of patterned ornament; but if the dyeing is wrong, black and yellow are turned into dark blue and purple. Lofty ridgepoles and ornamented roof posts present a magnificent sight; but if one is dazzled by usefulness where there is no substance, ridgepoles and beams are reduced to rafters. Different paths leading to the same destination express the unity of the universally applicable Way; but to travel in an empty carriage or a worn-out boat toward narrow, crooked passages and along foul puddles is to go astray. Thus, dyeing…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
之而善則善人矣染之而不
善則不善人矣是在人也用
之大則成大用之小則爲小
是在人也騖於紛華舍大道
而由徑竇焉是速化同塵非
遠器也
國家何賴焉爾多士涵泳
===
德敎誦法古昔明詩書以求適於
用所自期待非鮮淺也今顧
始進之也上之而篤棐寅亮
總一方略贊承化理於無疆
次之而屏翰四方經營底績
稱其股肱下之因事宣猷和
衷靖共亦不失一方之寄固
punctuated:
之而善，則善人矣；染之而不善，則不善人矣。是在人也。用之大，則成大；用之小，則爲小。是在人也。騖於紛華，舍大道而由徑竇焉，是速化同塵，非遠器也。國家何賴焉？
爾多士涵泳德敎，誦法古昔，明詩書以求適於用，所自期待非鮮淺也。今顧始進之也，上之而篤棐寅亮，總一方略，贊承化理於無疆；次之而屏翰四方，經營底績，稱其股肱；下之因事宣猷，和衷靖共，亦不失一方之寄。固
translation_en:
…if the influence upon them is good, they become good men; if the influence upon them is not good, they become men who are not good. This depends upon the person. Employ them in great affairs, and they achieve great things; employ them in small affairs, and their achievements are small. This depends upon the person. To pursue dazzling finery, abandon the great Way, and follow narrow paths and openings is to be swiftly transformed into conformity with the common dust, rather than to possess the capacity for lasting achievement. How could the state rely upon such men?
You scholars have steeped yourselves in moral instruction, recited and taken ancient exemplars as your models, and sought a clear understanding of the Book of Poetry and the Book of Documents so that you may put your learning to use. Your expectations of yourselves are neither meager nor shallow. Yet now you are only beginning your advancement. At the highest level, you may offer steadfast assistance and reverent aid to the ruler, unify plans and strategies, and assist in carrying forward his transforming governance without limit. At the next level, you may serve as bulwarks throughout the realm, manage affairs and bring undertakings to fruition, proving worthy to be his limbs. At a lower level, you may carry out his plans as particular affairs require, work in harmony, and serve with diligence and reverence, thus still proving worthy of responsibility for a locality. Surely…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
多士分内事也藉令毋貳爾
心不見異物而遷焉卽所樹
勛揚休皦然較著將世世永
有令聞有司者不與有聲施
哉先正有言下不負所學上
不負
天子是適用之謂也敬爲多士誦
===
之勗之
河南開封府許州郾城縣儒
學教諭何道瀾謹序
punctuated:
多士分内事也。藉令毋貳爾心，不見異物而遷焉，卽所樹勛揚休，皦然較著，將世世永有令聞，有司者不與有聲施哉？先正有言：「下不負所學，上不負天子。」是適用之謂也。敬爲多士誦之，勗之。
河南開封府許州郾城縣儒學教諭何道瀾謹序。
translation_en:
…these are indeed duties that fall to you scholars. Provided that you remain undivided in purpose and do not let unfamiliar things turn you aside, the achievements you establish and the distinction you display will shine forth clearly, and your good name will endure for generations. Will not the officials responsible also share in that renown? A worthy predecessor said: “Below, do not betray what you have learned; above, do not fail the Son of Heaven.” This is what it means to put learning to practical use. I respectfully recite these words to you scholars and exhort you with them.
Preface respectfully composed by He Daolan, Instructor of the Confucian School of Yancheng County, Xuzhou Subprefecture, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan.

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
江西鄕試録序
皇上御極之四十三年爲嘉靖甲
子天下當復大比士先是言
者請申飭科舉之法大臣廣
爲八事上之
天子曰可於是內外畿省罔不承
德毖事而士益感奮思自效視
===
疇曩加隆矣昔
高皇帝神武啓運首開取士之科
未遑定制閱十有七年甲子
始頒行成式今我
皇上右文圖治同符
聖祖而其事與時不先不後適與
之合豈非千百載希覯哉巡
punctuated:
江西鄕試録序

皇上御極之四十三年，爲嘉靖甲子，天下當復大比士。先是，言者請申飭科舉之法，大臣廣爲八事上之。天子曰可。於是內外畿省罔不承德毖事，而士益感奮思自效，視疇曩加隆矣。

昔高皇帝神武啓運，首開取士之科，未遑定制。閱十有七年，甲子，始頒行成式。今我皇上右文圖治，同符聖祖，而其事與時不先不後，適與之合，豈非千百載希覯哉？巡
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Jiangxi Provincial Examination

The forty-third year of His Majesty’s reign was the jiazi year of the Jiajing era [1564], when the empire was once again due to hold the triennial examination of scholars. Before this, those submitting recommendations had requested that the regulations governing the civil-service examinations be reaffirmed and rigorously enforced. The high ministers expanded these proposals into eight measures and submitted them to the throne. The Son of Heaven approved them. Thereupon, throughout the capital regions and provinces, all received his beneficent direction and attended carefully to their duties. Scholars, increasingly inspired, sought to prove themselves, with greater fervor than before.

Formerly, Emperor Gao, through his divine martial prowess, inaugurated the dynasty and first established examinations for selecting scholars, but had not yet had leisure to settle their regulations. Seventeen years elapsed before, in a jiazi year [1384], established rules were first promulgated and put into effect. Now our sovereign honors civil learning and strives for good government, in accord with the sage founder. These measures and their timing coincide precisely with that precedent, neither earlier nor later. Is this not something rarely witnessed in hundreds or thousands of years? The Regional Inspector…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
按江西監察御史楊栢率諸
司夙戒曰興賢登雋
國之懿典矧玆奉
明詔其曷敢不恪乃博徵四方文
學之官遠邇胥會以匡之曁
教諭何道瀾主考試教授蔣
遵正教諭黃應麟袁祚何一
===
達金守諒李遇春王國相項
德粹胡文遠易有辭爲同考
試而提調則左布政使侯一
元左參議馮謙監試則副使
周俶僉事楊美益分任厥務
咸愼以虔於是合提學副使
何鏜所選士二千三百有奇
punctuated: 按江西監察御史楊栢率諸司夙戒曰：「興賢登雋，國之懿典。矧玆奉明詔，其曷敢不恪？」乃博徵四方文學之官，遠邇胥會以匡之。曁教諭何道瀾主考試，教授蔣遵正、教諭黃應麟、袁祚、何一達、金守諒、李遇春、王國相、項德粹、胡文遠、易有辭爲同考試。而提調則左布政使侯一元、左參議馮謙，監試則副使周俶、僉事楊美益，分任厥務，咸愼以虔。於是合提學副使何鏜所選士二千三百有奇。
translation_en: …Yang Bai, the Investigating Censor inspecting Jiangxi, led the various offices and admonished them beforehand: “Promoting worthy men and advancing outstanding talent is a noble institution of the state. Now that we have received an enlightened imperial edict, how could we dare to be anything but reverent?” Accordingly, educational officials were summoned widely from all quarters; those from near and far assembled to assist in the undertaking. And He Daolan, an Instructor, presided as Examiner. Jiang Zunzheng, a Professor, and the Instructors Huang Yinglin, Yuan Zuo, He Yida, Jin Shouliang, Li Yuchun, Wang Guoxiang, Xiang Decui, Hu Wenyuan, and Yi Youci served as Associate Examiners. Hou Yiyuan, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Feng Qian, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner, served as Proctors; Zhou Chu, a Surveillance Vice Commissioner, and Yang Meiyi, an Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, supervised the examination. Each took responsibility for his assigned duties, and all acted with care and reverence. Thereupon, more than 2,300 candidates selected by He Tang, the Surveillance Vice Commissioner supervising education, were assembled…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
三試之取其雋九十有五人
錄其名氏幷文之可式者二
十篇以
獻臣之敬序諸首簡臣之竊惟
人臣之義莫大乎以人事君
而江西為吳楚閩越之會人
文特盛固平日所願一至其
===
地以觀其所謂比屋絃誦之
習淳固慤實之餘風而臣之
濫從是役得盡覩諸士之文
而品隲之以附得人之慶豈
非臣之大幸耶雖然亦竊有
大懼也
國家所賴於人才甚重而其求
punctuated:
三試之，取其雋九十有五人，錄其名氏幷文之可式者二十篇，以獻。臣之敬序諸首簡。臣之竊惟，人臣之義，莫大乎以人事君。而江西為吳楚閩越之會，人文特盛，固平日所願一至其地，以觀其所謂比屋絃誦之習、淳固慤實之餘風。而臣之濫從是役，得盡覩諸士之文而品隲之，以附得人之慶，豈非臣之大幸耶？雖然，亦竊有大懼也。
國家所賴於人才甚重，而其求
translation_en:
…Having examined them in three sessions, we selected ninety-five outstanding men, recorded their names together with twenty essays worthy of serving as models, and presented these to the throne. I, your servant, respectfully place this preface at the beginning of the record. I humbly consider that no duty of a subject is greater than serving his ruler by finding worthy men. Jiangxi stands at the meeting point of Wu, Chu, Min, and Yue, and its literary culture flourishes especially richly. I had long wished to visit this region once, to observe its celebrated custom of music and recitation in every household and its surviving traditions of simplicity, steadfastness, sincerity, and integrity. Having undeservedly been assigned to this duty, I was able to read all the candidates’ writings and assess them, thereby sharing in the rejoicing over the discovery of worthy men. Was this not my great good fortune? Nevertheless, I also privately feel great apprehension.
The state relies heavily upon talented men, and its search for them…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
之也亦甚難苟求矣或罔殫
厥心是謂弗忠殫厥心矣而
真才之未得是謂弗明頃者
大臣所
上議凡以勸夫忠與明也臣之自
入院偕諸同事者滌慮秉公
顓顓焉竭日夜之力其庶免
===
於弗忠矣乎而不明之罪則
願與爾諸士共勉焉夫諸士
今日之登於斯錄者言也異
時論定服官展采錯事樹煇
赫閎偉之業而垂聲施于無
窮則豈惟其言哉蓋古者文
章行業實出于一而敷奏明
punctuated:
之也亦甚難。苟求矣，或罔殫厥心，是謂弗忠；殫厥心矣，而真才之未得，是謂弗明。頃者大臣所上議，凡以勸夫忠與明也。臣之自入院，偕諸同事者滌慮秉公，顓顓焉竭日夜之力，其庶免於弗忠矣乎？而不明之罪，則願與爾諸士共勉焉。
夫諸士今日之登於斯錄者，言也。異時論定服官，展采錯事，樹煇赫閎偉之業，而垂聲施于無窮，則豈惟其言哉？蓋古者文章行業，實出于一，而敷奏明
translation_en:
…and seeking such talent is also exceedingly difficult. If one undertakes the search but fails to devote one’s whole heart to it, this is called a lack of loyalty; if one devotes one’s whole heart to it yet fails to find true talent, this is called a lack of discernment. The proposals recently submitted to the throne by the high ministers were all intended to encourage loyalty and discernment. Since entering the examination compound, your servant, together with his colleagues, has cleared his thoughts and upheld impartiality, single-mindedly exerting himself day and night. Might we thus hope to escape the charge of disloyalty? As for the fault of inadequate discernment, I hope that you scholars and I will strive together to avoid it.
What has earned you scholars a place in this record today is your writing. In the future, when assessments have been settled and you serve in office, display your abilities and conduct affairs, establish illustrious and magnificent achievements, and transmit your fame to generations without end—will it then be merely a matter of your writing? For in antiquity, literary composition, conduct, and accomplishments truly sprang from a single source; and the full presentation of reports and clear …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
試亦參相考也爾諸士誦說
詩書稱引先王則人人殊矣
類皆道其中之所得範之乎
繩墨而非掠取於外藻飾而
離其本者即以推究厥覆固
宜不甚相鑿然孔子聖人也
嘗曰文莫吾猶人也躬行君
===
子則吾未之有得其自責實
也如此至論觀人則曰有德
者必有言有言者不必有德
此其準也今爾諸士其果躬
行而文從之有德而有言乎
抑文有可觀而行之不逮有
言而不必有德乎匡之誠懼
punctuated: 試亦參相考也。爾諸士誦說《詩》《書》，稱引先王，則人人殊矣。類皆道其中之所得，範之乎繩墨，而非掠取於外、藻飾而離其本者。即以推究厥覆，固宜不甚相鑿。然孔子，聖人也，嘗曰：「文，莫吾猶人也；躬行君子，則吾未之有得。」其自責實也如此。至論觀人，則曰：「有德者必有言，有言者不必有德。」此其準也。今爾諸士，其果躬行而文從之，有德而有言乎？抑文有可觀而行之不逮，有言而不必有德乎？匡之誠懼
translation_en: …testing achievements also provides a means of checking one against the other. You gentlemen differ from one another in your recitations and explanations of the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents and in your references to the former kings. Generally, however, you all express what you have gained within yourselves, bringing it into conformity with established standards, rather than snatching things from outside and embellishing them while departing from their root. If we proceed from this to investigate what underlies your words [?], the two should surely not be greatly at odds. Yet Confucius, a sage, once said: “In literary learning, perhaps I am the equal of others; but as for personally putting the gentleman’s way into practice, I have not yet attained it.” Such was the earnestness with which he reproached himself. When discussing how to judge others, he said: “Those who possess virtue necessarily have something to say; those who have something to say do not necessarily possess virtue.” This was his standard. Now, you gentlemen: do you truly put the Way into practice, with your writing following from it, and possess virtue that finds expression in words? Or is your writing worthy of attention while your conduct falls short, so that you have words but do not necessarily possess virtue? Kuangzhi [?] truly fears…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
之也〔臣之〕按設科以來如唐
張九齡陸贄韓愈宋范仲淹
富弼歐陽脩赫然章灼於用
世而本之亦自言始也言固
不足以知人哉夫情動而言
形理發而文見蓋沿隱至顯
因内符外者也故賈生俊發
===
則文潔而體清長卿傲誕則
理侈而詞溢子雲沉寂則志
隱而味深班固雅懿則裁密
而思靡觸類以推表裏必符
劉勰之論豈虛也哉載觀春
秋之時諸侯卿大夫交接隣
國以微言相動當周旋進退
punctuated: 之也。〔臣之〕按：設科以來，如唐張九齡、陸贄、韓愈，宋范仲淹、富弼、歐陽脩，赫然章灼於用世，而本之亦自言始也。言固不足以知人哉？夫情動而言形，理發而文見，蓋沿隱至顯，因内符外者也。故賈生俊發，則文潔而體清；長卿傲誕，則理侈而詞溢；子雲沉寂，則志隱而味深；班固雅懿，則裁密而思靡。觸類以推，表裏必符。劉勰之論，豈虛也哉？載觀春秋之時，諸侯卿大夫交接隣國，以微言相動，當周旋進退
translation_en:
…this. 〔Your servant Zhi [?]〕 observes: Since the establishment of the examinations, men such as Zhang Jiuling, Lu Zhi, and Han Yu of the Tang, and Fan Zhongyan, Fu Bi, and Ouyang Xiu of the Song, have shone brilliantly in service to the world. Yet, tracing their beginnings, they too started with their words. Can words really be insufficient for knowing a person?

When feelings stir, words take form; when principles emerge, they become manifest in writing. Thus one proceeds from the hidden to the visible, with outward expression corresponding to what lies within. Hence Jia Sheng was brilliant and spirited, and his writing was pure and its form clear; Changqing was proud and unrestrained, and his reasoning was extravagant and his language overflowing; Ziyun was quiet and reserved, and his intent was concealed and his flavor profound; Ban Gu was refined and admirable, and his composition was closely structured and his thought finely wrought. Extending this reasoning to similar cases, the outward and inward must correspond. Could Liu Xie’s argument be empty?

Consider further the Spring and Autumn period, when the feudal lords, ministers, and grand masters maintained relations with neighboring states, moving one another through subtle words. In the course of their ceremonial exchanges, as they advanced and withdrew…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
之際必稱詩以喻其志蓋以
別賢不肖而觀盛衰焉進之
則虞夏商周之佐往矣卽其
陳謨矢訓作命敷誥猶可想
見其人與其所行之政昭然
若指諸掌也夫此皆異世也
尚能因言而知之況諸士之
===
同時者乎然則謂言不足以
知人亦非也諸士其毋忘乃
言而砥節勵行以成其信也
哉匡之又聞之記曰天下有
道則行有枝葉上之所敎也
化之本也易曰聖人久於其
道而天下化成敎之所孚也
punctuated:
之際，必稱詩以喻其志，蓋以別賢不肖而觀盛衰焉。進之，則虞夏商周之佐往矣。卽其陳謨、矢訓、作命、敷誥，猶可想見其人與其所行之政，昭然若指諸掌也。夫此皆異世也，尚能因言而知之，況諸士之同時者乎？然則謂言不足以知人，亦非也。諸士其毋忘乃言，而砥節勵行，以成其信也哉！
匡之又聞之，《記》曰：「天下有道，則行有枝葉。」上之所敎也，化之本也。《易》曰：「聖人久於其道，而天下化成。」敎之所孚也，
translation_en:
…in the course of their ceremonial exchanges, they invariably quoted the Odes to convey their intentions, thereby distinguishing the worthy from the unworthy and discerning signs of flourishing and decline. Going further back, the ministers who assisted the rulers of Yu, Xia, Shang, and Zhou have long since passed away. Yet through their presentations of counsel, declarations of instruction, formulation of commands, and delivery of proclamations, we can still picture the men and the government they conducted, as clearly as if pointing to something in our own palms. These men all belonged to other ages, yet we can still know them through their words. How much more, then, can we know you gentlemen, who live in our own time? Thus it is also mistaken to say that words are insufficient for knowing a person. May you gentlemen not forget your words, but temper your integrity and exert yourselves in your conduct, so as to make good on them!
I, Kuangzhi, have also heard this. The Record of Rites says: “When the Way prevails throughout the world, conduct has branches and leaves.” This is what instruction from those above brings about, and it is the foundation of moral transformation. The Book of Changes says: “The sage abides enduringly in his Way, and the transformation of all under Heaven is accomplished.” This is the effect of instruction taking hold…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
治之極也我
皇上至神極
聖作民
君師
敬一之箴
五箴之註鐫布膠庠以開示心
學之全而尤惓惓於行顧其
===
言之
訓大哉
皇言風天下以行也乃天下士際
值
昌隆涵濡鼓舞之久既能與行
而言其實而今又恭遇
皇上申明
punctuated: 治之極也。我皇上至神極聖，作民君師。《敬一之箴》《五箴之註》鐫布膠庠，以開示心學之全，而尤惓惓於「行顧其言」之訓。大哉，皇言！風天下以行也。乃天下士際值昌隆，涵濡鼓舞之久，既能與行而言其實，而今又恭遇皇上申明
translation_en:
…the highest attainment of governance. Our Emperor, supremely numinous and perfectly sagely, serves as ruler and teacher of the people. His Admonition on Reverent Oneness (Jingyi zhi zhen) and Commentary on the Five Admonitions (Wu zhen zhi zhu) have been engraved and distributed to the schools to reveal the full scope of the learning of the mind. He is especially solicitous about the injunction to “ensure that one’s conduct accords with one’s words.” Great indeed are the imperial words! They inspire all under Heaven to act.

The scholars of the realm have thus encountered an age of flourishing prosperity and have long been nurtured and inspired. They can already speak of the substance of their conduct [?], and now they again reverently encounter His Majesty’s reaffirmation of…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
意嚮
天日照臨之下爭自磨濯歲異而
月不同彬彬乎其可以虛文
視之哉臣之竊謂必有倜儻
奇偉効節不顧身者出而應
有司之求惟
天子所任使以媚於
===
上下光昭我
皇上壽考作人之化翊贊我
嘉靖萬年無疆之休而臣之未
知今之所錄者果有若人乎
否也使誠有之豈惟乃言底
績黎庶是賴抑將褒然爲科
目光而臣之獲知言知人之
punctuated: 意嚮。天日照臨之下，爭自磨濯，歲異而月不同，彬彬乎其可以虛文視之哉？臣之竊謂必有倜儻奇偉、効節不顧身者，出而應有司之求，惟天子所任使，以媚於上下，光昭我皇上壽考作人之化，翊贊我嘉靖萬年無疆之休。而臣之未知，今之所錄者果有若人乎否也？使誠有之，豈惟乃言底績，黎庶是賴，抑將褒然爲科目光，而臣之獲知言知人之
translation_en: …his intentions. Beneath the illuminating radiance of the imperial sun, they vie to refine and cleanse themselves, changing with every year and every month. So richly cultivated are they—can they be regarded as possessing merely empty literary polish? Your servant ventures to believe that there must be men of exceptional spirit and remarkable ability, who devote themselves loyally without regard for their own lives, coming forward to answer the responsible officials’ call. They will undertake whatever duties the Son of Heaven assigns them, winning favor above and below, gloriously displaying our Emperor’s transforming influence in nurturing worthy men throughout his long life, and assisting the boundless blessings of our Jiajing reign for ten thousand years. Yet what your servant does not know is whether those selected on this occasion truly include such men. If indeed they do, not only will their words yield achievements upon which the common people can depend; they will also bring conspicuous glory to the examination system, while your servant will gain the reputation of understanding words and knowing men …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
譽亦可釋不明之懼矣故匡
之于諸士之始進而願與交
勉以相成諸士其毋以匡之
為空言也哉是舉也巡撫江
西右副都御史周相鎮俗彰
軌譽髦斯勸提督南贛右僉
都御史吳百朋靖民輯武文
===
教用彰右布政使萬士和左
參政季德甫右參政張淵劉
光濟副使李佑陸州方弘靜
方攸績僉事胡順華毛汝麒
許彥忠參將梁守愚遊擊將
軍盧錡都指揮僉事趙文奎
咸襄理於外弼成盛美而右
punctuated:
譽，亦可釋不明之懼矣。故匡之于諸士之始進，而願與交勉以相成。諸士其毋以匡之為空言也哉！

是舉也，巡撫江西右副都御史周相，鎮俗彰軌，譽髦斯勸；提督南贛右僉都御史吳百朋，靖民輯武，文教用彰。右布政使萬士和、左參政季德甫、右參政張淵、劉光濟，副使李佑、陸州、方弘靜、方攸績，僉事胡順華、毛汝麒、許彥忠，參將梁守愚、遊擊將軍盧錡、都指揮僉事趙文奎，咸襄理於外，弼成盛美，而右
translation_en:
…the reputation [for discerning words and recognizing men] may also allay my fear of lacking discernment. Thus I offer this admonition as these scholars first advance into service, hoping that through mutual encouragement we may help one another attain fulfillment. May these scholars never regard this admonition as empty words!

For this examination, Zhou Xiang, Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, steadied local customs and made proper standards manifest, encouraging outstanding scholars through praise. Wu Baipeng, Supreme Commander of Nan-Gan and Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, brought peace to the people and order to military affairs, thereby fostering literary and moral instruction. Wan Shihe served as Right Provincial Administration Commissioner; Ji Defu as Left Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner; and Zhang Yuan and Liu Guangji as Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioners. Li You, Lu Zhou, Fang Hongjing, and Fang Youji served as Surveillance Vice Commissioners. Hu Shunhua, Mao Ruqi, and Xu Yanzhong served as Surveillance Assistant Commissioners. Liang Shouyu served as Regional Commander, Lu Qi as Mobile Corps Commander, and Zhao Wenkui as Assistant Regional Military Commissioner. All assisted with arrangements outside the examination compound and contributed to this splendid achievement, while the Right …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
參議蔡結僉事楊旆先期以
入
賀行右布政使王遵按察使陳
暹以遷秩行又皆協恭始事
監察御史姜儆署員外郎林
應雷主事李向陽張翰翔行
人戴鳳翔錦衣衛千戶李如
===
栢以使事至嘉樂厥成者也
於法竝得書
湖廣長沙府湘陰縣儒學教
諭錢匡之謹序
punctuated:
參議蔡結、僉事楊旆先期以入賀行，右布政使王遵、按察使陳暹以遷秩行，又皆協恭始事。監察御史姜儆、署員外郎林應雷、主事李向陽、張翰翔、行人戴鳳翔、錦衣衛千戶李如栢以使事至，嘉樂厥成者也，於法竝得書。
湖廣長沙府湘陰縣儒學教諭錢匡之謹序。
translation_en:
…Assistant Administration Commissioner Cai Jie and Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Yang Pei departed ahead of the appointed time to present congratulations at court. Right Administration Commissioner Wang Zun and Surveillance Commissioner Chen Xian departed upon promotion. All likewise worked together respectfully at the outset of this undertaking. Investigating Censor Jiang Jing, Acting Vice Director Lin Yinglei, Secretaries Li Xiangyang and Zhang Hanxiang, Messenger Dai Fengxiang, and Embroidered-uniform Guard Battalion Commander Li Rubai arrived on official missions and welcomed and rejoiced in its successful completion. According to the conventions, all are entitled to be recorded here.
This preface is respectfully written by Qian Kuangzhi, Instructor of the Confucian School of Xiangyin County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang.

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
蕩蕩乎民無能名焉
誠者非自成己而已也所以成物也
詩云雨我公田遂及我私惟助為有公田
由此觀之雖周亦助也設為庠序學校
以教之
易
中正以觀天下
===
玉鉉在上剛柔節也
夫乾其靜也專其動也直是以大生焉夫
坤其靜也翕其動也闢是以廣生焉廣
大配天地
象也者像此者也
書
九功惟敘九敘惟歌
協于克一俾萬姓咸曰大哉王言又曰一
哉王心
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

蕩蕩乎，民無能名焉。

誠者，非自成己而已也，所以成物也。

詩云：「雨我公田，遂及我私。」惟助為有公田。由此觀之，雖周亦助也。設為庠序學校，以教之。

易

中正以觀天下。

玉鉉在上，剛柔節也。

夫乾，其靜也專，其動也直，是以大生焉。夫坤，其靜也翕，其動也闢，是以廣生焉。廣大配天地。

象也者，像此者也。

書

九功惟敘，九敘惟歌。

協于克一，俾萬姓咸曰：「大哉王言！」又曰：「一哉王心！」
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

So vast was his greatness that the people could find no name for it.

Sincerity does not merely bring oneself to completion; it is also the means of bringing other things to completion.

The Book of Odes says: “Rain upon our public fields, and then reach our private fields.” Only the labor-assistance system has public fields. From this we see that even the Zhou used the labor-assistance system. Establish xiang, xu, xue, and xiao schools to instruct the people.

Book of Changes

Being central and correct, he surveys all under Heaven.

The jade carrying bar is at the top: firmness and yielding are duly regulated.

Qian, in stillness, is concentrated; in movement, it is direct. Thus it brings forth greatness. Kun, in stillness, is closed; in movement, it opens. Thus it brings forth breadth. This breadth and greatness match Heaven and Earth.

Images are representations of these things.

Book of Documents

The nine achievements are duly ordered; the nine ordered achievements are celebrated in song.

Unite in attaining oneness, so that all the people say: “Great are the king’s words!” And also: “Single in purpose is the king’s heart!”

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
會其有極歸其有極曰皇極之敷言是彞
是訓于帝其訓
斯謀斯猷惟我后之德
詩
瞻彼淇奥綠竹青青有匪君子充耳琇瑩
會弁如星
左之左之君子宜之右之右之君子有之
天子萬壽明明天子令聞不已
其笠伊糾其鎛斯趙以薅荼蓼
===
春秋
秋宋人齊人邾人伐郳〔莊公十有五年〕
九月晉侯宋公衛侯鄭伯曹伯會于扈晉
荀林父帥師伐陳〔宣公九年〕
公會晉侯宋公衛侯曹伯齊世子光莒子
邾子滕子薛伯杞伯小邾子伐鄭會于
蕭魚 楚人執鄭行人良霄〔俱襄公十有一年〕
夏楚子蔡侯陳侯鄭伯許男徐
子滕子頓子胡子沈子小邾子宋世子
punctuated:
會其有極，歸其有極，曰：「皇極之敷言，是彞，是訓，于帝其訓。」
斯謀斯猷，惟我后之德。

詩
瞻彼淇奥，綠竹青青。有匪君子，充耳琇瑩，會弁如星。
左之左之，君子宜之；右之右之，君子有之。
天子萬壽，明明天子，令聞不已。
其笠伊糾，其鎛斯趙，以薅荼蓼。

春秋
秋，宋人、齊人、邾人伐郳。〔莊公十有五年〕
九月，晉侯、宋公、衛侯、鄭伯、曹伯會于扈。晉荀林父帥師伐陳。〔宣公九年〕
公會晉侯、宋公、衛侯、曹伯、齊世子光、莒子、邾子、滕子、薛伯、杞伯、小邾子伐鄭，會于蕭魚。楚人執鄭行人良霄。〔俱襄公十有一年〕
夏，楚子、蔡侯、陳侯、鄭伯、許男、徐子、滕子、頓子、胡子、沈子、小邾子、宋世子
translation_en:
Gather those who possess the standard; turn to those who possess the standard. Say: “The sovereign’s exposition of the supreme standard is the constant rule and the instruction; it is the instruction of the Lord on High.”
These plans and these counsels are the virtue of our ruler.

The Odes
Look at that bend of the Qi River, where the green bamboo grows luxuriantly. There is our accomplished gentleman: his ear pendants are beautiful, gleaming stones, and the gems on his cap’s seams shine like stars.
Assist him on the left, on the left: the gentleman finds it fitting. Assist him on the right, on the right: the gentleman has their support.
May the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years! Illustrious is the Son of Heaven; his good renown is unending.
Their hats are woven closely; their hoes cut keenly, to weed out the bitter herbs and smartweed.

The Spring and Autumn Annals
In autumn, men of Song, Qi, and Zhu attacked Ni. 〔Fifteenth year of Duke Zhuang.〕
In the ninth month, the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, and the Earl of Cao met at Hu. Xun Linfu of Jin led an army to attack Chen. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xuan.〕
The duke joined the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Cao, Guang, heir apparent of Qi, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, the Viscount of Teng, the Earl of Xue, the Earl of Qi, and the Viscount of Little Zhu in attacking Zheng. They met at Xiaoyu. Men of Chu seized Liang Xiao, the diplomatic envoy of Zheng. 〔Both entries are from the eleventh year of Duke Xiang.〕
In summer, the Viscount of Chu, the Marquis of Cai, the Marquis of Chen, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, the Viscount of Xu, the Viscount of Teng, the Viscount of Dun, the Viscount of Hu, the Viscount of Shen, the Viscount of Little Zhu, and the heir apparent of Song …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
佐淮夷會于申〔昭公四年〕
夏公會齊侯于夾谷公至自夾谷齊人
來歸鄆讙龜陰田〔俱定公十年〕叔孫州
仇帥師墮郈季孫斯仲孫何忌帥師
墮費〔俱定公十有二年〕
禮記
德發揚詡萬物大理物博
其功大者其樂備其治辯者其禮具
天子者與天地參
===
事君先資其言拜自獻其身以成其信
第貳場
論
聖人與天地同體
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢春和議賑貸詔〔文帝元年〕
擬唐以李靖為定襄道行軍總管統諸軍
討突厥誥〔貞觀三年〕
擬宋以文彥博富弼同中書門下平章事
punctuated:
佐、淮夷會于申〔昭公四年〕。
夏，公會齊侯于夾谷。公至自夾谷。齊人來歸鄆、讙、龜陰田〔俱定公十年〕。叔孫州仇帥師墮郈。季孫斯、仲孫何忌帥師墮費〔俱定公十有二年〕。
禮記
德發揚詡萬物，大理物博。
其功大者，其樂備；其治辯者，其禮具。
天子者，與天地參。
事君，先資其言，拜自獻其身，以成其信。
第貳場
論
聖人與天地同體。
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢春和議賑貸詔〔文帝元年〕。
擬唐以李靖為定襄道行軍總管統諸軍討突厥誥〔貞觀三年〕。
擬宋以文彥博、富弼同中書門下平章事
translation_en:
…Zuo and the Huai Yi assembled at Shen. 〔Fourth year of Duke Zhao.〕
In summer, the duke met the Marquis of Qi at Jiagu. The duke returned from Jiagu. The people of Qi came to restore the lands of Yun, Huan, and Guiyin. 〔All in the tenth year of Duke Ding.〕 Shusun Zhouchou led an army to demolish the fortifications of Hou. Jisun Si and Zhongsun Heji led an army to demolish the fortifications of Fei. 〔Both in the twelfth year of Duke Ding.〕
Record of Rites
Virtue spreads forth and nurtures the myriad things; its ordering is great, and the things it embraces are abundant.
Those whose achievements are great have fully developed music; those whose governance is well ordered have fully established rites.
The Son of Heaven forms a triad with Heaven and Earth.
In serving a ruler, one first presents one's words, then bows and offers oneself in person, thereby fulfilling one's pledge of good faith.
Second Session
Discourse
The sage forms one body with Heaven and Earth.
Imperial Edicts, Proclamations, and Memorials 〔One topic set from among these [?].〕
Draft an edict for the Han dynasty ordering deliberation on relief loans during the mild spring season. 〔First year of Emperor Wen.〕
Draft a proclamation for the Tang dynasty appointing Li Jing as Commander-in-Chief of the Expeditionary Army of the Dingxiang Route, to command the armies in a campaign against the Tujue. 〔Third year of Zhenguan.〕
Draft, for the Song dynasty, [a memorial concerning] the appointment of Wen Yanbo and Fu Bi as Jointly Administrators of Affairs of the Secretariat–Chancellery…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
謝表至和二年
判語五條
講讀律令
轉解官物
禁止迎送
優恤軍屬
修理倉庫
第叁塲
策五道
===
問洪範之敘九疇詳矣然究其大要不過
皇建其有極斂時五福用敷錫厥庶民
數語而已豈非以
天子作民父母爲天下王固不獨建極以斂福
于躬而必敷極于天下使臣民會歸而
錫之以福歟三代而下此義微矣洪惟
我
太祖高皇帝用夏變夷置天下於衣冠禮樂之
域其所以敷極錫福者至深遠也嘗取
punctuated:
謝表，至和二年。
判語五條：講讀律令、轉解官物、禁止迎送、優恤軍屬、修理倉庫。
第叁塲
策五道
問：洪範之敘九疇詳矣，然究其大要，不過「皇建其有極」、「斂時五福，用敷錫厥庶民」數語而已。豈非以天子作民父母，爲天下王，固不獨建極以斂福于躬，而必敷極于天下，使臣民會歸而錫之以福歟？三代而下，此義微矣。洪惟我太祖高皇帝，用夏變夷，置天下於衣冠禮樂之域，其所以敷極錫福者至深遠也。嘗取
translation_en:
…a memorial of thanks. Second year of the Zhihe reign (1055).

Five legal judgments, on: lecturing on and reading the statutes and ordinances; forwarding government property; prohibiting ceremonial welcoming and seeing off; providing preferential relief to military families; and repairing granaries and storehouses.

Third Session
Five Policy Questions

Question: The Great Plan sets out its nine categories in detail. Yet, when we examine its essential purport, it amounts to no more than these few words: “The sovereign establishes the supreme standard” and “Gather these five blessings, and distribute them among the common people.” Is this not because the Son of Heaven, acting as father and mother to the people and as king of all under Heaven, must assuredly do more than establish the supreme standard to gather blessings upon himself? Must he not also spread that standard throughout the realm, so that officials and people alike converge upon it, and bestow blessings upon them? Since the Three Dynasties, this meaning has become obscure. We reverently reflect that our Emperor Taizu Gao transformed the barbarians through the civilization of Xia, bringing all under Heaven into the domain of proper dress, ritual, and music. The means by which he spread the supreme standard and bestowed blessings were profound and far-reaching indeed. He once took…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
蔡氏傳而
親訂之則
聖祖于皇極之義觀其深矣又有所謂
存心錄
精誠錄與
諭宋濂人心虛靈之言其於皇極之理相通
否歟我
皇上憲
天法
===
祖久道化成奇祥上瑞互見疊出其所以斂福
者至備矣邇者
鼎新
殿門悉取皇極之義名之蓋欲天下臣民咸
歸于極而自求多福也其揭示洪範之
要尤彰明較著矣豈
聖祖釐正書傳之意固有所所在而必待于
今日歟甞伏讀
御製
punctuated:
蔡氏傳而親訂之，則聖祖于皇極之義，觀其深矣。又有所謂《存心錄》、《精誠錄》，與諭宋濂人心虛靈之言，其於皇極之理相通否歟？
我皇上憲天法祖，久道化成，奇祥上瑞，互見疊出，其所以斂福者至備矣。邇者鼎新殿門，悉取皇極之義名之，蓋欲天下臣民咸歸于極而自求多福也。其揭示《洪範》之要，尤彰明較著矣。豈聖祖釐正書傳之意，固有所所在，而必待于今日歟？甞伏讀御製
translation_en:
…Cai’s Commentary and personally revised it. Thus, the sagely ancestor’s understanding of the meaning of the August Standard was profound [?]. There are also the works called Record of Preserving the Mind and Record of Perfect Sincerity, together with his admonition to Song Lian concerning the mind’s emptiness and spiritual awareness. Do these accord with the principle of the August Standard?
Our Emperor takes Heaven as his rule and his ancestor as his model. Through long perseverance in the Way, his transforming influence has reached fulfillment. Extraordinary auspicious signs and supreme portents have appeared in succession; his means of gathering blessings are most complete. Recently, in renewing the palace halls and gates, he named them all according to the meaning of the August Standard. His intention is surely that all subjects throughout the realm should turn to that standard and seek abundant blessings for themselves. His exposition of the essentials of the “Great Plan” is especially clear and manifest. Could it be that the sagely ancestor’s intention in correcting the commentary on the Book of Documents had a particular purpose all along, whose realization necessarily awaited this very day? I have reverently read the imperially composed…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
敬一箴
四箴註與
重華殿各置經書備覽詩我
皇上建極之學可以仰而窺也抑有契於
聖祖諸所著述歟夫頌世德而稱先王孝之大
也揚
主上之明聖以宣示遐邇臣之忠也諸士涵濡
道化久矣其悉意鋪張之以昭我
聖天子繼述之盛
===
問記有之曰禮樂刑政其極一也所以同
民心而出治道也稽之往古作樂以象
成明刑以弼教二者固為政之大端矣
書載后夔所奏戛擊鳴球搏拊琴瑟下
管鼗鼓柷敔笙鏞與周大司樂其屬磬
鐘笙鏄靺師籥師籥章鞮鞻氏所掌同
歟異歟夫苟同也而論樂者謂武未盡
善豈周公不逮后夔歟或謂大司樂宜
隸之宗伯而何以屬之地官歟虞庭象
punctuated:
《敬一箴》、《四箴註》與《重華殿各置經書備覽詩》，我皇上建極之學可以仰而窺也。抑有契於聖祖諸所著述歟？夫頌世德而稱先王，孝之大也；揚主上之明聖，以宣示遐邇，臣之忠也。諸士涵濡道化久矣，其悉意鋪張之，以昭我聖天子繼述之盛。

問：記有之曰：「禮樂刑政，其極一也，所以同民心而出治道也。」稽之往古，作樂以象成，明刑以弼教，二者固為政之大端矣。《書》載后夔所奏，戛擊鳴球，搏拊琴瑟，下管鼗鼓柷敔笙鏞，與周大司樂其屬磬鐘笙鏄靺師籥師籥章鞮鞻氏所掌，同歟異歟？夫苟同也，而論樂者謂武未盡善，豈周公不逮后夔歟？或謂大司樂宜隸之宗伯，而何以屬之地官歟？虞庭象
translation_en:
…the Admonition on Reverent Unity, the Commentary on the Four Admonitions, and the Poem on Placing Classical Books in the Chonghua Hall for Consultation: through these we may reverently glimpse our emperor’s learning concerning the establishment of the supreme standard. Does it not accord with the various writings of the sagely founder? To praise the virtue transmitted through the generations and extol former kings is the highest expression of filial piety; to proclaim the reigning sovereign’s enlightened sagacity to those far and near is a minister’s loyalty. You scholars have long been steeped in the transforming influence of the Way. Set this forth fully and with all your care, so as to illuminate the splendor with which our sagely Son of Heaven continues and fulfills his predecessors’ work.

Question: The Record of Rites says: “Rites, music, punishments, and government have a single ultimate purpose: to unite the people’s hearts and bring forth the way of good government.” Looking back to antiquity, music was created to represent accomplishments, and punishments were made clear to support moral instruction. These two were certainly major elements of government. The Book of Documents records the music performed by Kui: striking the resonant jade chimes, playing the qin and se zithers, and, below the hall, pipes, pellet drums, drums, wooden percussion instruments marking the beginning and ending of the music, mouth organs, and large bells. Were these the same as, or different from, what was administered by the Zhou Grand Director of Music and his subordinates responsible for chimes, bells, mouth organs, and large bells [?], the mo masters [?], the flute masters, the officers of flute music, and the officers of foreign music? If they were the same, yet those who discuss music say that the Wu dance was not entirely good, could it be that the Duke of Zhou fell short of Kui? Some say that the Grand Director of Music ought to have been subordinate to the Minister of Rites; why, then, was he assigned to the Ministry of Education [?]? At the court of Shun, the representation …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
以典刑流宥五刑鞭作官刑朴作教刑
金作贖刑五刑有服五流有宅與周大
司寇之職掌建邦之三典糾萬民之五
刑同歟異歟小司寇又有以五聲求民
情以八辟麗邦法以三刺斷獄訟何象
魏之布較虞爲獨詳歟秋官掌邦禁矣
而大司徒有以鄉八刑糾萬民者又何
歟漢唐而下代有作者雖詳略互異豈
無可指而言者歟惟我
===
太祖高皇帝汛掃胡元肇造區夏首
命詹同陶凱製宴享九奏復以大成樂器頒之
學校特
勅劉惟謙重會衆律
親御翰墨爲之裁定而又有
大明令以詔告之與有虞成周之制果相脗合
否乎抑師其意而不必盡同歟二百年
來
聖化涵濡法守畫一真足以和上下洽民心而
punctuated: 以典刑，流宥五刑，鞭作官刑，朴作教刑，金作贖刑，五刑有服，五流有宅，與周大司寇之職掌建邦之三典、糾萬民之五刑，同歟異歟？小司寇又有以五聲求民情，以八辟麗邦法，以三刺斷獄訟，何象魏之布較虞爲獨詳歟？秋官掌邦禁矣，而大司徒有以鄉八刑糾萬民者，又何歟？漢唐而下，代有作者，雖詳略互異，豈無可指而言者歟？惟我太祖高皇帝汛掃胡元，肇造區夏，首命詹同、陶凱製宴享九奏，復以大成樂器頒之學校，特勅劉惟謙重會衆律，親御翰墨爲之裁定，而又有《大明令》以詔告之，與有虞、成周之制果相脗合否乎？抑師其意而不必盡同歟？二百年來，聖化涵濡，法守畫一，真足以和上下、洽民心而
translation_en:
…by means of the regular punishments, with exile used to mitigate the Five Punishments, the whip prescribed for official discipline, the rod for instruction, and payments in metal for redemption from punishment. The Five Punishments had their prescribed applications, and the five forms of exile their designated destinations. Were these the same as, or different from, the duties of the Zhou Minister of Justice, who established the state's three penal codes and corrected the myriad people through the Five Punishments? The Vice Minister of Justice also ascertained the people's true circumstances through five aspects of their testimony, applied the state's laws through the eight grounds for deliberation, and decided criminal cases and litigation through three consultations. Why were the provisions promulgated at the palace gate towers so much more detailed than those of Yu? The Ministry of Autumn was responsible for the state's prohibitions; why, then, did the Minister of Education also correct the myriad people through the eight punishments of the districts? From the Han and Tang onward, every dynasty had those who instituted such systems. Though these differed in detail and scope, surely there are examples that can be identified and discussed?
Our Emperor Taizu Gao swept away the non-Chinese Yuan and founded his rule over the Chinese realm. He first ordered Zhan Tong and Tao Kai to compose the nine musical movements for court banquets, and subsequently distributed instruments for the Music of Great Perfection to the schools. He specially commanded Liu Weiqian to collate the various statutes anew, personally taking up brush and ink to settle their provisions. There were also the Ordinances of the Great Ming, through which he proclaimed his commands. Did these actually accord with the institutions of Yu and Zhou? Or did they follow their intent without necessarily being identical in every respect? For two hundred years, the sage transforming influence has permeated all, and observance of the laws has been uniform—truly sufficient to harmonize those above and below, unite the people's hearts, and …

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
治道之隆媲美於帝王之盛矣諸士子
其尚論而揚厲之無讓
問文之爲道也遠矣粤自風姓迄于孔氏
莫不創典述訓經緯天地夫何心哉三
代之文至戰國而病涉秦漢復起漢之
文至列國而病唐興復起固也不知漢
唐之文亦有足稱者歟魏文之論陸機
之賦獨孤郁之辯李德裕之箴皆以知
文名抑孰爲要歟夫文一也或曰君子
===
之文志士之文詞士之文或曰朝廷之
文室家之文官司之文政刑之文敎化
之文又若是其不同何也今諸士子以
文進矣願宗經徵聖以觀志之所向
問江右自昔多賢炳耀史冊玆未暇論已
近楊氏竊取朱子之法爲
皇明名臣言行錄視彭氏所賛加詳焉夷考其
人有匡弼
四朝相業卓然者有撫綏南服國計裕如者有
punctuated:
治道之隆，媲美於帝王之盛矣。諸士子其尚論而揚厲之，無讓。
問：文之爲道也遠矣。粤自風姓迄于孔氏，莫不創典述訓，經緯天地，夫何心哉？三代之文至戰國而病，涉秦漢復起；漢之文至列國而病，唐興復起，固也。不知漢唐之文亦有足稱者歟？魏文之論、陸機之賦、獨孤郁之辯、李德裕之箴，皆以知文名，抑孰爲要歟？夫文一也，或曰君子之文、志士之文、詞士之文，或曰朝廷之文、室家之文、官司之文、政刑之文、敎化之文，又若是其不同，何也？今諸士子以文進矣，願宗經徵聖，以觀志之所向。
問：江右自昔多賢，炳耀史冊，玆未暇論已。近楊氏竊取朱子之法，爲《皇明名臣言行錄》，視彭氏所賛加詳焉。夷考其人，有匡弼四朝、相業卓然者，有撫綏南服、國計裕如者，有
translation_en:
…the flourishing of good government rivals the finest ages of the ancient emperors and kings. You candidates should discuss and extol this achievement without holding back.
Question: Literature as a Way has a long history. From the one surnamed Feng [Fu Xi] down to Confucius, all created canons and transmitted teachings, giving ordered form to Heaven and Earth. What purpose moved them? The literature of the Three Dynasties declined in the Warring States period and revived through the Qin and Han; Han literature declined in the period of divided kingdoms and revived with the rise of the Tang. This is accepted. Yet were there also features of Han and Tang literature worthy of praise? Emperor Wen of Wei in his discourse, Lu Ji in his rhapsody, Dugu Yu in his disquisition, and Li Deyu in his admonition all won renown for their understanding of literature. Which best captures its essentials? Literature is one, yet some speak of the literature of gentlemen, of men of resolve, and of literary specialists; others speak of the literature of the court, of households, of government offices, of administration and punishments, and of moral instruction. Why should it differ in so many ways? You candidates now seek advancement through literature. We ask you to take the Classics as your foundation and seek confirmation in the sages, so that we may discern the direction of your aspirations.
Question: Jiangyou [Jiangxi] has produced many worthy men since ancient times, whose brilliance shines in the historical records; for now, we have no leisure to discuss them all. Recently, Master Yang borrowed Zhu Xi’s method to compile the Record of the Words and Deeds of Eminent Ministers of the August Ming, providing greater detail than the work compiled by Master Peng. Upon examining these men, we find one who assisted and sustained four reigns, with outstanding achievements as grand secretary; another who pacified and secured the southern territories, leaving the state’s finances amply provided for; and another who…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
身率諸生翕然從化者有敎倣安定勃
然興起者有掌制校文不負他日令器
之許者有三疏百首無忝八面受敵之
才者有力抑奔競之風者有抗論起復
之非者有首揭三綱而忠義足尚者有
復陳十事而剴切不回者有守蘇郡而
比之張詠者有守南雄而比之范丹者
有棄舉業之學嘆箋註之繁而徵聘至
京固辭還山者此其言行章章較著者
===
也爾諸士生其鄉不知其人可乎行將
出而用世矣乃所願則何居焉
問江西介在吳楚閩粵之中天下稱隩區
焉自島夷繹騷漳泉潮惠以來山箐溪
峒之頑乗間竊發往歲流突臨吉荼毒
甚矣賴我
皇上軫念東南俯從建議特設東西中營於三
郡要地環峙聯絡扼塞諸路已無遺策
但各營召募類非土著而無事坐糜轉
punctuated:
身率諸生，翕然從化者；有敎倣安定，勃然興起者；有掌制校文，不負他日令器之許者；有三疏百首，無忝八面受敵之才者；有力抑奔競之風者；有抗論起復之非者；有首揭三綱，而忠義足尚者；有復陳十事，而剴切不回者；有守蘇郡，而比之張詠者；有守南雄，而比之范丹者；有棄舉業之學，嘆箋註之繁，而徵聘至京，固辭還山者。此其言行章章較著者也。爾諸士生其鄉，不知其人可乎？行將出而用世矣，乃所願則何居焉？

問：江西介在吳楚閩粵之中，天下稱隩區焉。自島夷繹騷漳泉潮惠以來，山箐溪峒之頑，乗間竊發，往歲流突臨吉，荼毒甚矣。賴我皇上軫念東南，俯從建議，特設東西中營於三郡要地，環峙聯絡，扼塞諸路，已無遺策。但各營召募類非土著，而無事坐糜轉
translation_en:
…those who personally led the students, who united in following their transforming influence; those whose teaching followed Anding’s example and brought about a vigorous revival; those who drafted imperial pronouncements and assessed examination compositions, fulfilling the earlier prediction that they would become men of great capacity; those whose three memorials and hundred poems proved worthy of their talent for meeting challenges from all eight directions; those who vigorously curbed the pursuit of advancement through competition for favor; those who spoke out against the impropriety of recalling officials to service during mourning; those who first proclaimed the Three Bonds, whose loyalty and righteousness deserve esteem; those who again submitted ten proposals, incisive and unyielding; those who governed Suzhou and were compared to Zhang Yong; those who governed Nanxiong and were compared to Fan Dan; and those who abandoned examination studies, deplored the proliferation of annotations, and, summoned to the capital, firmly declined appointment and returned to the mountains. These are the men whose words and deeds are conspicuously recorded. You scholars were born in their native region: can you fail to know these men? Soon you will enter public life and serve the world. Which of these examples, then, do you aspire to follow?

Question: Jiangxi lies amid Wu, Chu, Min, and Yue, and is known throughout the realm as a sheltered region. Since the island barbarians began causing repeated disturbances [?] in Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, Chaozhou, and Huizhou, the unruly inhabitants of the mountain thickets and stream valleys have seized opportunities to rise in rebellion. In past years they swept through Linjiang and Ji’an, inflicting terrible suffering. Fortunately, our Emperor, concerned for the southeast, graciously accepted the proposal to establish Eastern, Western, and Central Garrisons at strategic locations in three prefectures. Positioned around the region and linked together, they block all routes, leaving no defensive measure unprovided for. Yet the men recruited into these garrisons are mostly not local inhabitants, and in peaceful times they idly consume supplies, which in turn…

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
苦供億之難即欲漸次撤遣倘有緩急
何以應之甞攷
國初立萬戸府以簡民兵彼皆十年一選充
者不可行於今乎議者謂團練郷兵可
以免客兵之費今各府精常等兵要之
皆操備也豈必易民而教之乎况額徴
有限而兵餉無窮此甚可慮者也古之
人有賦田臨羌者有雜耕渭濵者此以
兵而給食者也有閒田募弓弩手者有
===
請田募民保甲者此以食而寓兵者也
不識可採而行之乎夫民不加賦而軍
需自足兵不加募而軍威自振當事者
終歳咨諏而未得其要也爾諸士生長
於斯憂莫先焉其為我極言之
punctuated: 苦供億之難，即欲漸次撤遣，倘有緩急，何以應之？甞攷國初立萬戸府以簡民兵，彼皆十年一選充者，不可行於今乎？議者謂團練郷兵可以免客兵之費，今各府精常等兵，要之皆操備也，豈必易民而教之乎？况額徴有限，而兵餉無窮，此甚可慮者也。古之人有賦田臨羌者，有雜耕渭濵者，此以兵而給食者也；有閒田募弓弩手者，有請田募民保甲者，此以食而寓兵者也。不識可採而行之乎？夫民不加賦而軍需自足，兵不加募而軍威自振，當事者終歳咨諏而未得其要也。爾諸士生長於斯，憂莫先焉，其為我極言之。
translation_en:
…suffer from the difficulty of provisioning them. Even if we wished to withdraw and discharge them gradually, how would we respond should an emergency arise? I have examined how, at the founding of the dynasty, myriarchies (wanhu fu) were established to select militia troops from among the people. These men were selected to fill the ranks once every ten years. Could this practice not be implemented today? Those discussing the matter say that organizing and training local militia could spare us the expense of troops brought in from elsewhere. Yet the ‘selected’ and ‘regular’ troops [?] now maintained in the various prefectures are, in essence, all trained for defensive service. Must we replace them with ordinary civilians and train those instead? Moreover, assessed revenues are finite, while expenditure on military provisions is endless. This is a matter of grave concern.

Among the men of antiquity, some allotted farmland at Linqiang, and some had soldiers cultivate land interspersed among civilian fields along the Wei River. These used soldiers to provide food. Others used vacant fields to recruit archers and crossbowmen, or requested land and recruited civilians into the baojia system of mutual security. These used the provision of food to maintain military forces. Might these methods be adopted and put into practice?

To make military supplies sufficient without increasing the people's taxes, and to strengthen military might without recruiting additional soldiers—the responsible officials deliberate and seek advice throughout the year, yet have not grasped the essentials. You scholars were born and raised here; no concern should take precedence over this. Explain the matter fully for me.

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
中式舉人九十五名
第一名祝眉壽德興縣學生易
第二名廖如春吉水縣學增廣生詩
第三名吳思學廣昌縣學增廣生書
第四名李伯廉金谿縣學生春秋
第五名姚士觀廣信府學生禮記
第六名姜忻南昌縣學增廣生詩
第七名宋良佐萬載縣學生易
===
第八名樊璽建昌府學附學生書
第九名彭樂尹分宜縣學生易
第十名仝遷南昌府學附學生詩
第十一名周冕廬陵縣學增廣生易
第十二名方繼懋武寧縣學生春秋
第十三名黃榜廣昌縣學生書
第十四名陳文燦臨川縣學生詩
第十五名劉良弼南昌府學生禮記
第十六名袁應旂豐城縣學增廣生易
punctuated:
中式舉人九十五名。

第一名，祝眉壽，德興縣學生，《易》。第二名，廖如春，吉水縣學增廣生，《詩》。第三名，吳思學，廣昌縣學增廣生，《書》。第四名，李伯廉，金谿縣學生，《春秋》。第五名，姚士觀，廣信府學生，《禮記》。第六名，姜忻，南昌縣學增廣生，《詩》。第七名，宋良佐，萬載縣學生，《易》。第八名，樊璽，建昌府學附學生，《書》。第九名，彭樂尹，分宜縣學生，《易》。第十名，仝遷，南昌府學附學生，《詩》。第十一名，周冕，廬陵縣學增廣生，《易》。第十二名，方繼懋，武寧縣學生，《春秋》。第十三名，黃榜，廣昌縣學生，《書》。第十四名，陳文燦，臨川縣學生，《詩》。第十五名，劉良弼，南昌府學生，《禮記》。第十六名，袁應旂，豐城縣學增廣生，《易》。
translation_en:
Ninety-five successful provincial graduates (juren).

First: Zhu Meishou, a student of the Dexing County School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.

Second: Liao Ruchun, an added student of the Jishui County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.

Third: Wu Sixue, an added student of the Guangchang County School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.

Fourth: Li Bolian, a student of the Jinxi County School. His examination classic was the Spring and Autumn Annals.

Fifth: Yao Shiguan, a student of the Guangxin Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Rites.

Sixth: Jiang Xin, an added student of the Nanchang County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.

Seventh: Song Liangzuo, a student of the Wanzai County School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.

Eighth: Fan Xi, an attached student of the Jianchang Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.

Ninth: Peng Leyin, a student of the Fenyi County School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.

Tenth: Tong Qian, an attached student of the Nanchang Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.

Eleventh: Zhou Mian, an added student of the Luling County School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.

Twelfth: Fang Jimao, a student of the Wuning County School. His examination classic was the Spring and Autumn Annals.

Thirteenth: Huang Bang, a student of the Guangchang County School. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.

Fourteenth: Chen Wencan, a student of the Linchuan County School. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.

Fifteenth: Liu Liangbi, a student of the Nanchang Prefectural School. His examination classic was the Book of Rites.

Sixteenth: Yuan Yingqi, an added student of the Fengcheng County School. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.

title: 嘉靖四十三年江西鄉試錄
text:
第十七名俞汝諧撫州府學生詩
第十八名汪宛弋陽縣學生書
第十九名黃時濟豐城縣學增廣生易
第二十名周邦傑撫州府學增廣生詩
第二十一名江梅臨川縣學附學生易
第二十二名劉伯潮吉安府學附學生春秋
第二十三名伍定相臨川縣學附學生詩
第二十四名吳堪臨川縣學附學生易
第二十五名管煦雩都縣學生書
